## Week-by-Week Schedule

**Fall 2026 class meetings:** Mondays and Wednesdays, 5:30–6:45 PM, PAM 30.

Normally, content lectures include an in-class quiz. There is no quiz for the guest lecture, TA-led project discussions, the milestone poster session, or spotlight presentations. The three lowest quiz scores are dropped. A TBD session is quiz-eligible only if it becomes a content lecture.

:::{.callout-tip}
